breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet and Periodic types. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary conditions: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions: u(0,t)=1 at x=0 and u(1,t)=0 at x=1', thus resolving the inconsistency.
